question: Does the OpenAI Agents SDK surface MCP resource reads to the model?
method: static inspection of the installed openai-agents 0.23.1 (adapter venv)

evidence.agents.mcp.util.get_function_tools: builds the model toolset from list_tools ONLY; no call to list_resources or resources/read
evidence.MCPServerStreamableHttp: has list_resources/read_resource methods for manual app use, but the Agent loop never calls them
evidence.Agent: has no 'resources' field; resources are not part of the model-visible toolset

conclusion: The model cannot read an MCP resource through the OpenAI Agents SDK as the harness uses it. Class 6 (resource-content injection) is N/A on the OpenAI scaffold.
note: LangGraph and Claude Agent SDK are determined by a D17-style probe before their first result (PREREG N/A rule).
